source.snippet: I see companies having codebase in Tauri going back to electron - is this a common thing? [4 comments, 4 points, captured 2026-08-28]

problem_statement: Engineering teams that migrated from Electron to Tauri are reverting back, suggesting Tauri's cross-platform desktop framework has unresolved production pain points (missing APIs, ecosystem gaps, or maintenance burden) that make the switch costly to sustain.
target_segment: Software engineering teams at startups and SMBs shipping cross-platform desktop apps.
notes: Engineering team context (companies with codebases) implies real budget and time cost in migration/reversion cycles. The revert pattern suggests an unserved need: either migration tooling, compatibility shims, or consulting to de-risk the switch. Signal is thin (single HN comment/question) but directionally interesting for tooling or audit services.
